summary: Researched Atkore as one immutable electrical-infrastructure security. Electrical volume growth supports the grid and data-centre demand link, but input-cost inflation materially exceeded pricing, margins compressed, six-month operating cash flow turned negative, and portfolio changes obscure normalised earnings. Updated the security to watching and queued one bounded relationship review; no valuation or strategy is supportable without a fresh mark and evidence of margin and cash recovery.

evidence.claim: For the quarter ended 27 March 2026, net sales rose 4.2% to USD 731.4 million and Electrical sales rose 8.1%, but consolidated gross margin fell to 18.6% and adjusted EBITDA declined 30.4% to USD 81.1 million.
Quarterly input costs increased by USD 82.1 million while selling prices contributed USD 10.2 million; management maintained fiscal-2026 adjusted EBITDA guidance of USD 340-360 million.

Six-month operating cash flow was negative USD 27.2 million, cash was USD 442.3 million, debt carrying value was about USD 760.6 million, and a USD 136.5 million litigation settlement reduced financial flexibility.
